cycle_bifurcation.terminal_rule: upper/lower when final x > 1.2 and abs(final y) > 0.5; otherwise unresolved

groups.incoming_left: 12 positions around (-0.18,-0.18), independent N(0,0.015^2 I) jitter
groups.incoming_right: 12 positions around (0.18,-0.18), independent N(0,0.015^2 I) jitter

figure_eight.crossing_rule: first entry within radius 0.12 then first exit beyond radius 0.35; exit x sign
figure_eight.terminal_rule: sign of final x (left/right), with x=0 unresolved

coupling: one fine Brownian stream per seed/topology, summed into coarser increments
initialization: specified positions encoded as simulator normal draws using start position and start-node sigma*0.1
comparator_caveat: dt=0.0025 is a numerical comparator, not exact continuous-time truth
